description: This file contains the implementation of the Metadata class for handling metadata collection, aggregation, and rebasing within the GN build system. It includes methods for walking metadata dependencies, rebasing paths, and managing metadata scope values.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Class responsible for handling metadata collection, walking, and rebasing in the GN build system.

methods.name: WalkStep
methods.description: Performs a recursive walk over metadata dependencies, collecting specified data keys and determining next dependencies to visit.

methods.name: RebaseValue
methods.description: Rebases a metadata value based on its type (string, list, scope) to a new path.

methods.name: RebaseStringValue
methods.description: Rebases a string metadata value to a new path.

methods.name: RebaseListValue
methods.description: Rebases a list of metadata values.

methods.name: RebaseScopeValue
methods.description: Rebases a scope (dictionary) of metadata values.
